findings.charge: The subject's purpose asserts it disambiguated corpus v6 from leftover-join.v6 'wherever a bare v6 stood', but two bare v6 tokens survive in positions where, at v7, the token has more than one live referent inside this same document.
evidence: basedOn.windowsPathV1.role reads 'NAMES-only catalog of the three v6 Windows-only TC-PATH members: reserved device names, trailing dot, trailing space.' This sentence is carried byte-for-byte from leftover-join.v6. At v6 the only cited v6 was the corpus; at v7 the document also cites leftover-join.v6, whose own obligations[OBL-WINDOWS-PATH].reason begins 'v6 notAuthored Windows-only TC-PATH: reserved device names, trailing dot, trailing space' — so 'the three v6 Windows-only TC-PATH members' now resolves equally to corpus v6 notAuthored and to leftover-join.v6's obligation. The intended referent is corpus v6: v7 rewrote the parallel sentence in obligations[OBL-WINDOWS-PATH-NAMED].reason to 'the three live corpus v6 notAuthored Windows-only TC-PATH members' but left this role untouched.

obligations[OBL-OD-2].reason reads '(Claude v6 advisories V6-A2/V6-A3)'. Those advisories originate in Claude's review of component-manifest-schemas.v6 and are carried through schemas.v10/v11 ('carried Claude v6 advisories V6-A2 and V6-A3' — unambiguous inside schemas.v11 where v6 can only mean schemas v6). Lifted into this join, 'Claude v6 advisories' sits in a document that also pins a Claude review of leftover-join.v6 (basedOn.predecessorV6.reviews.claude) and a corpus v6, and names schemas.v6 nowhere. The bare token is a third v6 referent the purpose's disambiguation rule was written to remove.

purpose: 'Disambiguate corpus v6 (component-manifest-fixture-corpus.v6) from leftover-join.v6 wherever a bare v6 stood.' The diff against leftover-join.v6 shows the rewrite landed in obligations[1,3,4,5,6,8,10].reason and authoredFixtureAudit.note, and missed the two loci above. The purpose therefore overstates what v7 did.
The review prompt's attack list names this exact defect: 'a bare v6 still stands where corpus v6 and leftover-join.v6 are ambiguous'.
findings.whyThisMatters: This artifact is a custody record whose value is that every version token resolves to exactly one artifact. The lineage already paid for that rule once (CLAUDE-PTLJ-V3-SF1, landed at v4, added 'Not this artifact's version number' to every predecessor role). A reader who takes 'the three v6 Windows-only TC-PATH members' as leftover-join.v6's members would read the windows-path catalog as consuming a leftover-join rather than the corpus, inverting the naming direction the role is there to state.

evidence: Live text: '... Frozen g15 leftover-join.v5 remains current G15 GATE leftover-join. Frozen packaging leftover-join.v4 remains current DR-120 leftover-join. Frozen v4 remains a historical measurement as of HEAD 5d5d778. Frozen v5 is not recorded.'

Read against the immediately preceding sentence, 'Frozen v4 remains a historical measurement as of HEAD 5d5d778' contradicts D-266 (packaging leftover-join.v4 is the current DR-120 leftover-join, not a historical measurement at 5d5d778 — that HEAD is component-manifest leftover-join.v4's pin). 'Frozen v5 is not recorded' contradicts D-270 (g15 leftover-join.v5 is recorded). Both sentences are true only of component-manifest leftover-join.v4 and .v5, which the clause never names.

Provenance: in leftover-join.v6 the same two sentences were unambiguous because that clause named only component-manifest lineage artifacts ('with file 08, leftover-join v5, G15 v7, windows-path catalog v1, and this draft unmoved'). v7's remeasurement is what put a foreign v4 and v5 beside them; the carried sentences no longer mean what they were written to mean — the same species as CLAUDE-CMLJ-V5-SF1.

Every other reference to this lineage's own predecessors in v7 is qualified ('leftover-join.vN', 'predecessorVN', 'Not this artifact's version number'). These two are the only unqualified ones, and they sit in the one clause that mixes three lineages.
Prompt: 'component-manifest leftover-join, g15 leftover-join, and packaging leftover-join are different lineages; their version numbers are unrelated.'
